name: embed-exploration-bench2
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate the quality and utility of text embedding models across common embedding use-cases such as semantic similarity, retrieval, and clustering. It provides tasks and datasets for measuring how well embeddings capture semantic relatedness and support nearest-neighbor retrieval and downstream clustering. The benchmark is intended for comparing embedding models and settings (e.g., pooling strategies, dimensionality) under standardized retrieval/similarity metrics.
reputation: A niche, experimental dataset used by researchers exploring embedding behavior rather than a widely adopted community benchmark.
